subject: Metricization & Runway: Clearsail trial KPIs and owners
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Iyer <maya@clearsail.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap — metric slate & next steps for Clearsail trial

Thanks again for taking the call today, Maya — good conversation and lots of alignment. This thread captures the commitments we discussed and proposes an initial success slate so your team can review quickly. Please flag anything you'd change.

Quick recap / goals
- Trial focus: 1) Production latency at 95th percentile, 2) sustainable throughput under your peak patterns, 3) cost per token estimate and run-rate, 4) quality on intent classification and entity extraction evaluation tasks.
- Duration: 4-week evaluation window (can compress if you want a faster cut).

Proposed success criteria (initial)
- Latency: p95 end-to-end generation latency <= 150 ms on our hosted endpoint (ish — we’ll instrument from your client to measure).
- Throughput: sustained 180–220 qps for 30m windows with <= 5% error rate.
- Cost: baseline projected cost <= $0.0025 per token at expected batching/usage; target optimized cost <= $0.0018/token with batching + cache.
- Quality: extractive F1 >= 0.86 on your labeled set (50 samples), and a human-verified pass rate >= 90% on 100 blind queries across intents.

Ownership & owners (initial)
- Redwood runtime & instrumentation: Marcus Lin (marcus.lin@redwood.ai) — will provision dedicated trial pool and set up latency/trace hooks.
- Evaluation datasets & quality judge: Maya + Clearsail evaluation team (eval@clearsail.ai) — please share the labeled samples and blind-set link.
- Trial cadence & logistics: Olga (me) will run weekly syncs and capture go/no-go decision at the end of week 4.

Immediate next steps (this week)
1) Clearsail: share sample workload and 50 labeled examples + 100 blind queries (drive link works).
2) Redwood: provision trial endpoint and share postman/curl examples; provide initial cost projection by EOD Friday.
3) Both: quick onboarding call for infra (Marcus + your infra lead) to confirm request shaping and auth (Tues morning suggested).

Attachments: I’ve attached a lightweight KPI template and a sample workload spec for your ingestion team.

Thanks — will follow up with the scheduled kickoff invite once we have dataset links.

—
Olga Petrov
Enterprise Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192
From: Maya Iyer <maya@clearsail.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Clearsail - Evaluation Team <eval@clearsail.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap — metric slate & next steps for Clearsail trial

Thanks Olga — this is great and aligns to what we discussed. A few notes from our side: 

- We can deliver the 50 labeled examples and 100 blind queries by Friday morning; I’ll send a drive link to the eval team artifacts.
- On quality thresholds: F1 0.86 is reasonable as a starting bar for extraction; for intent classification we’re also tracking top-1 accuracy (target >= 92%). Please include that as a secondary metric.
- On cost: can Redwood also return a sensitivity analysis (cost at 50k, 250k, 1M tokens) so we can estimate run-rate if we scale?

We're good for the Tuesday infra touchpoint — I’ll invite our infra lead, Priya Shah, and we'll confirm the time.

Quick ask: can Marcus include the expected schema for traces/labels so our instrumentation team maps fields to your traces?

Best,
Maya
Head of AI Ops | Clearsail
maya@clearsail.ai
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@clearsail.ai>, Maya Iyer <maya@clearsail.ai>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 08:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap — metric slate & next steps for Clearsail trial

On Thu, Apr 29, 2027 at 08:07 AM Maya Iyer <maya@clearsail.ai> wrote:
> Thanks Olga — this is great and aligns to what we discussed. A few notes from our side: ...

Hi team — attaching the minimal trace schema and example curl for posting requests to the trial endpoint. Highlights:
- Trace fields: request_id, client_timestamp, server_timestamp, model_variant, seq_len, tokens_in, tokens_out, p95_latency_ms (computed), error_flag.
- We'll expose per-route token counts and batching stats so you can map cost sensitivity.
- For the sensitivity analysis: I’ll run three cost projections and share a short table (50k / 250k / 1M tokens) by EOD.

Marcus Lin
Senior Platform Engineer, Runtime — Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai

Attachment stubs: minimal_trace_schema_v1.json (see attached), trial_endpoint_curl.sh
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Iyer <maya@clearsail.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 09:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap — metric slate & next steps for Clearsail trial

Perfect — thanks Maya and Marcus. Confirming the kickoff plan and timeline: 

1) Thu 29 Apr (today): Marcus posts trace schema + Redwood shares cost sensitivity table (in thread).
2) Fri 30 Apr: Clearsail uploads labeled set + blind queries; Redwood completes provisioning and hands over credentials.
3) Mon 3 May: Trial starts (day 0) — Redwood will collect baseline metrics for first 48 hours.
4) Week 1 (Mon 3–Fri 7 May): baseline run & small iterations; weekly sync #1 on Fri 7 May to review p95, throughput, initial quality scoring.
5) Week 2: optimization phase (batching, cache hints, model knobs) — Redwood owners: Marcus; Clearsail owners: Maya + Priya.
6) Week 4: final evaluation and go/no-go decision.

Action items (assigned)
- Clearsail: upload datasets by EOD Friday (Maya).
- Redwood: cost sensitivity + trial creds + sample curl (Marcus).
- Redwood: calendar invites for weekly syncs (Olga).

If anything slips, we’ll compress week 2 optimizations into week 1 and extend trial by a week as needed. Looking forward to getting started.

—
Olga Petrov
Enterprise Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai
